title: A Name That Was Never Entered
story: The inn ledger listed every guest except the woman in the blue coat, though the cook remembered her soup and the stable hand remembered her horse. That night's page was full, with no scraped erasure and no crowded extra line. Cora compared the ink. Every other name had been written with the house pen, which skipped on the downstroke. The woman's name had not been written and rubbed away. It had never been entered. Someone had taken cash and kept her off the page, while the staff who served her had no reason to invent her. The puzzle was not a vanished guest. It was a deliberate omission.

vocabulary.definition: The book in which guests are listed
A rubbed-out mark where writing was removed
The downward movement of the pen
Done on purpose, not by accident

quiz.question: Who recalled the animal she left at the inn?
options: The stable hand
The cook who remembered soup
A guest already written on the page
The pen that skipped
quiz.explanation: The stable hand remembered her horse.
quiz.supportingSentence: The inn ledger listed every guest except the woman in the blue coat, though the cook remembered her soup and the stable hand remembered her horse.

quiz.question: Which habit of the house pen did Cora use?
options: It skipped on the downstroke
It wrote only in blue ink
It erased a line without a mark
It belonged to the woman in the coat
quiz.explanation: The house pen skipped on the downstroke.
quiz.supportingSentence: Every other name had been written with the house pen, which skipped on the downstroke.

quiz.question: What does a full page with no scrape imply?
options: Her name was left out from the start, not removed later
She never came to the inn at all
The cook invented the bowl of soup
The stable hand stole the ledger
quiz.correctAnswer: Her name was left out from the start, not removed later
quiz.explanation: No erasure and ink that was never applied mean the name was never written.
quiz.supportingSentence: That night's page was full, with no scraped erasure and no crowded extra line.

quiz.question: What does omission name in the last line?
options: A purposeful leaving-out from the record
A horse kept in the stable overnight
A line crowded with extra names
Ink that skips on a downstroke
quiz.correctAnswer: A purposeful leaving-out from the record
quiz.explanation: An omission here is the deliberate act of leaving her name off the page.

quiz.question: Why point out the lack of a scraped erasure?
options: To rule out a name that was written and later removed
To describe the colour of her coat
To prove the cook could not write
To show the inn had no guests that night
quiz.correctAnswer: To rule out a name that was written and later removed
quiz.explanation: The missing scrape closes the explanation that someone rubbed a written name away.
quiz.supportingSentence: That night's page was full, with no scraped erasure and no crowded extra line.
